name: Boku wa Anata ni Koi o Suru - Futari Dake no Love Song
original_name: ボクはアナタに恋をする - 二人だけのラブソング
source:
A relative wants to help you with your dream of working in the music industry and invites you to the wedding party of a record company president.

Once you’re there, you get to meet many famous musicians and in the end, you get employed! How will you act in front of the artists, and how will your heart cope with the inevitable trouble?

[Edited from [url=http://visulog.jp/page/application/bokuanata/index2]official website[/url]]

The love interests in this game are the vocalists of several famous Japanese visual kei bands: Aoi from Aoi-168-, Yugiri from DaizyStripper, Mahiro from Kiryu, Mitsu from v[NEU], Yo-ka from Diaura, and Subaru from Royz.
